portedFromTheOracle.timer: src/game-loop.js updateDiving(), after updateCCR(): `if (ceilDepth > 0 && depth < decoStop(ceilDepth)) dcsViolationTime += dtDiveSeconds; else dcsViolationTime = Math.max(0, dcsViolationTime - dtDiveSeconds);` with ceilDepth = frameCalc.ceiling. Model: failure.dcsViolationS, from the step's decompression limits and decoStopDepth().
portedFromTheOracle.endChecks: Legacy's order: out of gas, O2 toxicity, `dcsViolationTime >= DCS_VIOLATION_TIME` (60), barotrauma, hypoxia, narcosis, `depth < 0.5 && ceilDepth > 3`. The model has no barotrauma or narcosis yet (#189); detectFailure() checks the rest in that order.
portedFromTheOracle.rebreatherFailures: updateCCR()'s failures return from updateDiving() before the DCS check, so the model leaves the timer where it was on that step.
portedFromTheOracle.text: GAME_OVER_INFO['DECOMPRESSION SICKNESS'] and STRINGS.*.gameOverReasons, English and German, as gameOver.reason.decompressionSickness and gameOver.info.decompressionSickness.*; claims register GAMEOVER-001 lists them.
